dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: Ahh... I—It's you... I'm really sorry about the treasure, and for having caused you so much trouble. Anyway, I'm very thankful for your help!

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: Will you continue to travel? To be honest, I never want to leave my house again after what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are you doing lately?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: Not too bad, all thanks to you.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission has been here asking about my whereabouts as well. Good thing dad covered for me.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: He somehow went and got a certificate saying I was unfit for service. Of course, the name on it says "Saimon Katsumi"!

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: Though it was quite expensive, at least I don't have to worry about being treated as a deserter...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are your plans for the future?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: The future? Hah, do I look like someone who has a future to speak of?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: ...Hey, hey, I'm just kidding. After that near-death experience, I've become extremely optimistic about the future.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: I'm done with the adventuring though. My focus should be my family for now...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: It just so happens that many of the village fields have gone barren. I'll spend my time farming and living life like the rest of the people here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You've become more down-to-earth, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: Heh, I suppose so.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: My parents are getting old as well, so I can't just sit around and do nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: And Konda Village is a place with history. I've also learned my lesson from last time...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: This time, I plan to stay home and wait for fortune to come to me! Maybe one day I'll dig up some old artifact and I'll be rich!

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: Ahem... I mean... I'll have enough money to provide for my parents...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Come on, where's your ambition?

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: Shh! You'll get me yelled at by my father...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: I start trembling whenever I think of what happened before... I don't dare to have any ideas at this point...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: I'll just tend to the fields, and who knows? Maybe one day luck will come my way.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: Yup! Good luck to you in your travels!
